props.name: actionRender
props.description:
Renders trailing actions for each item in the default item, inside `tree.ItemAction`.
Custom `itemRender` content composes `tree.ItemAction` directly.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: indentGuide
props.description: Whether nested items draw vertical guide lines for their ancestor levels.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Renders one visible item. Defaults to trigger, check box when checkable, the icon
returned by `getIcon`, label, and `actionRender` actions.
Use `tree.Item` as the root of the rendered content.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown in the trigger while children load.

props.name: scrollToItem
props.description: Scrolls a focused item into view using its flattened index.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: transition
props.description: Whether expanding and collapsing nested content animates its height.

props.name: unmountOnHide

props.name: variant
